Covered by the terminal queue/build resubmit eligibility module, including failed/removed build evidence.

Covered by the terminal queue/build resubmit eligibility module, including removed queue records and cleanup synchronization.
Covered by the identity-preserving resubmit module, which keeps the existing plan identity instead of recreating it.

Planned in the same preservation module: keep existing recommendation references/links in canonical records through resubmission and recovery flows.
Planned build-side resubmission handling so handoff creates fresh build lifecycle evidence and stale submitted-status evidence no longer blocks readiness.
Planned queue-side lifecycle renewal and queue/recovery surface propagation for resubmitted handoff.
Planned a recovery regression module covering failed build or removed queue cleanup through resubmit and handoff, with provenance/source-reference preservation checks.
Planned the test-interface validation surface for AC-010 around the required root quality commands: pnpm test, pnpm type-check, and pnpm maintainability:check.
Planned the test subsystem work as an existing-suite quality gate, with failures remediated until all required commands exit 0.
